# User-granted scoped case reapproval after per-glyph PNG placement

Recording the user's explicit **“Approve updates and finish”** decision, relayed by the parent after independent Spec review. This is the user-granted approval, **not an autonomous approval decision by the coding agent**.

Exact approved batch: `sha256:3074ae5df1aa0c91743c68f4217f066370698f3d8970bac02dec5b1aacc00e84`. Batch decision: https://github.com/sagikazarmark/excalidraw-render.orig/issues/85#issuecomment-5751047975

This comment records approval of these exact prospective case subjects:

- `focused.bidi-text.v1` — `sha256:9fc60fe6485a8af4d2b7754b23d7acb3dc95b3bbe30fe2365d6a078302f2184f`; replace-exact-exception; `default/png/whole`; 2375 pixels / `3fec7b0fe0040f08`.
- `focused.bidi-alignment.v1` — `sha256:5f4c10af4dc0fa04ee268a16163fc4e66e0ac7aa2a13d0c23b7fbcaa0d0446a5`; replace-exact-exception; `default/png/whole`; 1903 pixels / `3feac3b632cb3ae3`.
- `focused.text-alignment-vertical.v1` — `sha256:f9f652a17ea64b4db5615c58f1d83eca7ce0e40b55c30b43a5c5cd6bc5adc972`; withdraw-canonical-passing-exception; `default/png/whole`; 20 pixels / `3feffafe6d0ff9a4`.

The four replacement records use the actual approved per-glyph placement rule and existing non-defect causes; the two withdrawals remove stale exceptions now passing canonical gates. All official reference evidence, scenes, options, geometry, report expectations and unrelated fields are unchanged. The #168 SVG limitation pin is unchanged. These case decisions authorize the normal `record-approval` operation for the listed subjects; they do not grant global closure or refresh the native baseline.
